name: Full-Stack Feature Development
description: Parallel code generation with architectural dependencies

tasks.prompt: Design system architecture for a real-time job search dashboard. Define: data models, API contracts, component structure, state management approach. Return detailed design document.
Based on architecture design, generate FastAPI backend scaffold with models, routes, and database setup. Include proper structure and dependencies.
Based on architecture design, generate Next.js frontend scaffold with component structure, API clients, and state management. Include proper project setup.
Implement core API endpoints for job search dashboard: GET /jobs, POST /jobs, GET /jobs/{id}, DELETE /jobs/{id}. Include validation and error handling.
Implement React components for job dashboard: JobList, JobCard, SearchBar, FilterPanel. Use TypeScript, Tailwind, and match API contracts.
Integrate frontend and backend: wire up API calls, handle loading/error states, ensure end-to-end functionality. Provide integration checklist.
Generate test suite: unit tests for API endpoints, component tests for React, integration tests for critical paths. Include test configuration.
Create documentation: README with setup instructions, API documentation, component usage guide, deployment guide.
